description: This file defines a Java class 'CreocoreLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition' that extends 'PropertiesCondition' and overrides the 'matches' method to determine if Creocore loan transaction processor is enabled, based on the application properties.

classes.name: CreocoreLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition
classes.description: A condition class that checks whether the Creocore transaction processor is enabled in the Fineract properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the 'matches' method to return true if the Creocore transaction processor is enabled in the provided FineractProperties.
